en.title: Closing Cost-Quality Gap in Document VLMs: Difficulty-Aware Data Curation and Deployment Economics
en.hook: Learn how to bridge the cost-quality gap in document VLM deployments for highly regulated industries.
key_takeaways: Addresses high costs of structured extraction in regulated environments
Utilizes difficulty-aware data curation to optimize performance
Balances deployment economics with document processing quality

zh.title: 缩小文档视觉语言模型的成本-质量差距：难度感知数据筛选与部署经济学
zh.hook: 探索如何在严格监管的行业中降低文档处理成本，同时保持高质量的视觉语言模型性能。
key_takeaways: 解决受监管环境中结构化信息提取的高昂成本问题
利用难度感知的数据筛选优化模型性能
平衡部署经济效益与文档处理质量
